requirements: R1: Found documents must be openable inline without downloading
R2: If a document fails to load inline or is an unsupported format, the user must receive a clear error message and a fallback option to download.

slices.title: Implement inline document viewing
slices.jtbd: When implementing document inline viewing for this epic, I want to patch the existing code, so that the knowledge base allows opening files in the browser.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a found document in the catalog search results, When the user clicks the open/view action, Then the document content opens in an inline viewer.
Given a document ID, When requesting inline document viewing from the API, Then the server returns the document with inline content headers.
Given the document is opened in the inline viewer, When viewed on a mobile device or screen reader, Then the layout adapts and remains fully accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA).
Given an inline document request fails or the format is unsupported, When the viewer attempts to load, Then a clear error message and a fallback download link are presented.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce document download requirement from 100% to 0% for pure viewing tasks.

requirements: R1: Catalog search results must support pagination via API page/size parameters and frontend UI controls
R2: If fetching the next page of results fails, the user must be notified and given the option to retry.

slices.title: Implement catalog search pagination
slices.jtbd: When implementing catalog search results pagination for this epic, I want to patch existing code, so that large sets of document records are loaded efficiently.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search query returning multiple document results, When requesting search results from the API, Then page and size query parameters are supported.
Given catalog search results exceeding page capacity, When viewing results in the frontend, Then pagination controls are provided to navigate pages.
Given the user interacts with pagination controls, When a page change occurs, Then visible feedback is shown and focus is managed for screen readers (WCAG 2.1 AA).
Given a page change request fails, When the API returns an error, Then a notification is shown and the user is provided a retry option without losing current state.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce search API response time by 80% for queries matching >100 documents.

epics.title: Coverage Audit Gap Remediation
epics.jtbd: When maintaining the system's quality assurance, I want the coverage audit to explicitly verify all brief points against shipped code, so that gaps in delivery are accurately identified.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase coverage audit requirement coverage from partial to 100%.
requirements: R1: The coverage audit report must address brief points 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 and fully cover point 4.
R2: Every entry in the coverage audit report must explicitly name the file or merged PR that shows it is covered.
R3: If the required audit files cannot be found or read, the task must fail safely and indicate the missing paths.

slices.title: Patch coverage audit report missing criteria
slices.jtbd: When implementing the coverage audit gap fix for this epic, I want to patch the audit JSON file to include all missing requirements, so that the audit criteria are fully met.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the wishlist and report path recorded in this task's payload, When this audit ends, Then the report states for every requirement whether shipped code covers it.
Given the wishlist and report path recorded in this task's payload, When this audit ends, Then the report names the file or merged PR that shows it.
Given the system cannot locate the specified audit files, When the task runs, Then it aborts safely and logs the exact missing path as a blocker.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce missing evidence references in coverage audit reports to 0%.

requirements: R1: The task graph file must be written exactly to the recorded output path without duplicate copies.
R2: If writing to the recorded path fails, the script must report the exact error instead of falling back to a duplicate location.

slices.title: Fix duplicate task graph file paths
slices.jtbd: When fixing the task graph file path for this epic, I want to remove duplicate output files and write to the correct path, so that orchestration workflow can reliably execute it.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the malformed task graph file, When the patch is applied, Then it is written exactly to the recorded output path in the payload.
Given this role completes the Atomic Goal, When the relevant verification command runs, Then the change passes without unrelated scope.
Given the change is reviewed, When the PR diff is inspected, Then it contains only files needed for this slice.
Given a blocker remains after one objective attempt, When the Jules session would otherwise loop, Then the agent stops and records one concrete blocker or follow-up.
Given the target directory is read-only or invalid, When the script attempts to write, Then it exits cleanly and logs the write error.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce plan file duplication errors to 0%.
